name: This Is Spinal Axe
summary: Ug’thok in Orgrimmar asks you to gather spines from the huge beasts of Thunder Ridge. He hopes to shape them into an axe head for your smithing lessons.

sections.title: A smith’s idea
sections.body: Ug’thok asks you to bring five Weathered Spines and five Rough Grinding Stones. He believes the spines could make a fine axe head, though Saru laughed at the idea.

sections.title: Tough material
sections.body: The spines are tougher than Ug’thok expected, which may make them difficult to work. He plans to keep shaping the design.

faq.q: Who is asking for the spines?
faq.answer: Ug’thok in Orgrimmar asks you to gather Weathered Spines and Rough Grinding Stones.

faq.q: What does Ug’thok want to make?
faq.answer: Ug’thok hopes to make an axe head from the beasts’ spines.

faq.q: Where do the spines come from?
faq.answer: The Weathered Spines come from the huge beasts of Thunder Ridge.
Ug’thok asks for Rough Grinding Stones along with the spines.

faq.q: Why does Ug’thok want the materials?
faq.answer: Ug’thok wants to try making an axe head from the spines as part of your smithing lessons.

angles.text: As a smithing student, you help Ug’thok gather materials for an axe head he hopes to make.
